selection_rule: User intent selects a lane; lane state never changes the global operating contract.

lanes.purpose: Multiversal Sound & Audio Studio (MSAS): integrated creator workflow for governed sound, music, voice and audio production over existing AAI/PCA/DWC/resource/runtime contracts.
source_bundle: live lane execution state from ops3-lane-state/msas
AAI/PCA/DWC and other owner contracts named by the selected MSAS item
live application repository evidence limited to active MSAS scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Read MRCS/MVPS only for explicit dependencies or publication conflicts. MSAS execution never pauses, replaces or rewrites MRCS or MVPS.

lanes.purpose: Multiversal Rules & Content Studio (MRCS): creator-facing governed reusable rule/content definition authoring over Content Forge and owner-domain contracts.
source_bundle: live lane execution state from ops3-lane-state/mrcs
only owner-domain/PDCP/CAB/Content Forge sources named by the selected MRCS item
live application repository evidence limited to active MRCS scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Read MSAS/MVPS only for explicit dependencies or publication conflicts. MRCS execution never pauses, replaces or rewrites MSAS or MVPS.

lanes.purpose: Multiversal Player Species (MVPS): species as fully functioning game objects, including composition, morphology, grants, forms, adaptations, validation, projection, migration, UI/authoring and cross-system conformance.
intent_examples: work on player species game objects
source_bundle: live lane execution state from ops3-lane-state/mvps
Project/Feature/UI/Screen Bibles and DB-004 references named by the active MVPS item
live application repository evidence limited to active MVPS scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Consume shared owner contracts as explicit dependencies. Read MSAS/MRCS only for explicit dependencies or publication conflicts; do not mutate their selectors.

lanes.purpose: Governance architecture, repositories, CI, agent behavior, execution infrastructure, validation infrastructure and operational tooling.
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Implementation state may be read only to preserve or reconcile it; operations work may not silently start implementation work.

lanes.purpose: Game-system evaluation, world/game content design, mechanics design and content creation that does not itself authorize software implementation.
source_bundle: canonical source material needed for the requested domain
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Do not load implementation-roadmap control state unless the user asks to integrate the result into implementation.

lanes.purpose: The DWC speech-synthesis project and its corpus/training/inference workflow.
source_bundle: the current DWC checkpoint/evidence named there
live DWC artifacts supplied by the user
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Keep DWC isolated from implementation lanes unless an explicit integration task requires both.

lanes.purpose: External research, tools/resources evaluation, vendor/open-source comparisons and technical investigation that does not itself mutate product state.
source_bundle: project constraints only when they affect the evaluation
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Research findings become implementation or operations work only through an explicit follow-on task.

lanes.purpose: Source ingestion, provenance, corpus coverage, licensing traceability and recovery of project source material.
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Source evidence may inform other lanes but does not select their work.

retired_lane_aliases.product-development: Retired umbrella. Resolve explicit intent to msas, mrcs or mvps; this alias cannot select work.
retired_lane_aliases.ui-implementation: UISR-11 completed_verified. UISR is completed program history, not a persistent implementation lane.
retired_lane_aliases.player-species: Retired alias for canonical mvps lane.

parallel_persistence_rule: MSAS, MRCS and MVPS are independent persistent implementation lanes with separate milestone-only lane-state refs. Ordinary lane state records only start, complete exact-head prequeue GREEN, durable application publication and one post-closeout successor reseed. Intermediate repository/PR/CI/READY mechanics are not journaled. Shared-repository publication remains FIFO among immutable green READY candidates only.
